# Builder.io

Builder.io is a visual development platform for delivering, managing, and programmatically updating content, models, assets, and Space configuration.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/builder-io/.

## Actions

- **Create Content Entry**: Create a draft, published, or archived entry in an existing Builder.io model.
- **Delete Content Entry**: Delete one Builder.io content entry by model name and entry ID.
- **Get Content Entry** (read-only): Retrieve one content entry by model name and entry ID from the connected Builder.io Space.
- **Get Space Details** (read-only): Return the authenticated Builder.io Space ID and its read-only settings.
- **List Assets** (read-only): List, filter, and sort assets in the connected Builder.io Space without modifying the Asset Library.
- **List Content Entries** (read-only): List and filter content entries from any model in the connected Builder.io Space, one offset-controlled page at a time.
- **List Content Folders** (read-only): List the content folders configured in the connected Builder.io Space.
- **List Models** (read-only): List the content models in the connected Builder.io Space, optionally including each model's field schema for content discovery.
- **List Space Users** (read-only): List users and roles with access to the connected Builder.io Space.
- **Update Content Entry**: Partially update an existing Builder.io content entry.
